name: runesmith-sprint
description: [RuneSmith v1.0.0] The planner and builder loop. /task writes a task comm and its /goal line, /check-comms verifies Claude Code's replies against the repository and archives finished work, /promote moves a build from dev to qa to beta to main on the owner's word, and /qa-checklist publishes one checklist page per project where you mark each item pass or fail. Optional Jira wiring: /enable, /start-sprint, /sprint-status, /plan-to-tickets.
